from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta, timezone
import uuid


def format_utc(dt):
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


# Wednesday == weekday() 2
today = date.today()
days_until_wed = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7
if days_until_wed == 0:
    days_until_wed = 7  # today is Wednesday -> next week's Wednesday
next_wed = today + timedelta(days=days_until_wed)

local_tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
start_local = datetime(next_wed.year, next_wed.month, next_wed.day, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=local_tz)
end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=1)

uid = str(uuid.uuid4()) + "@example.com"
dtstamp = format_utc(datetime.now(timezone.utc))

lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
    f"DTSTART:{format_utc(start_local)}",
    f"DTEND:{format_utc(end_local)}",
    "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]

ics_content = "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"

with open("team_meeting.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(ics_content)

print("Event written to team_meeting.ics")
print(f"Today:            {today} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Next Wednesday:   {next_wed}")
print(f"Start (local):    {start_local.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')}")
print(f"End (local):      {end_local.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')}")
print(f"Start (UTC):      {start_local.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')}")
print(f"End (UTC):        {end_local.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')}")
print(f"Local timezone:   {local_tz}")
